reviews.text: This palette is about the size of my palm. The glitters are so fine and delicate. It features three finishes: matte, shimmer, and glitter—all in beautiful shades of pink and mauve. Even the silver glitter in the top left has these pink and purple reflects in it. Just looking at it puts me in such a great mood!
reviews.zh: 呢個眼影盤大約同我個手掌咁大。閃粉好細緻精緻。佢有三種質感：啞光、珠光同閃粉，全部都係好靚嘅粉紅同玫瑰紫色調。就連左上角嗰款銀色閃粉，都反光出粉紅同紫色嘅光。淨係睇住佢，心情都即刻好好！

reviews.text: this is another palette that is absolutely stunning. the colors are so pretty and versatile!! the balm it comes with is nice, too. i highly recommend this palette, especially with how cute the hearts are!! 💖
reviews.zh: 呢個又係一個超級靚嘅眼影盤。顏色好靚，好百搭！！附送嗰支 balm 都好好。我好推薦呢個眼影盤，尤其係嗰啲心形圖案好可愛！！💖

reviews.text:
summary: amazing colour range for cool toned people and the amount of colours included in this palette makes it flexible for travel and everyday use 
—
so impressed by the colour payoff and how buttery the shades are! i (cool tone) recently learnt a lot of my makeup is warm toned so i decided to try out cool toned makeup 

the 4 glitter shades in this palette are soo pretty and the photo could not do it the justice it needs. theyre so pretty and mainly on the pinky side (which makes sense for cool tone) dasique never disappoints on glitters 🙂‍↕️

[1 pink chunky glitter with holographic glitter
1 fine pink glitter shade (reminds me of a pink highlighter shade, lid topper shade)
1 fine whiteish pink with icy shimmer (opal, pearl qualities)
1 fine pink pearl shimmer
1 white pearl]

i have the dasique 3x3 palette and theyre around the same size. 

in all its been a long time since i’ve been this impressed by a palette, so i highly recommend this as a staple palette
reviews.zh:
總結：對冷色調嘅人嚟講，色系選擇非常豐富，而且盤入面色號數量多，令佢啱旅行同日常使用。
——
發色同色號嘅質地真係好絲滑，令我好驚喜！我（冷色調）最近先知道自己好多化妝品都係暖色調，所以決定試吓冷色調嘅妝容。

呢盤嘅 4 款閃粉都好靚，相片未能充分展現佢嘅效果。佢哋好靚，主要係粉紅色系（對冷色調嚟講好啱）。Dasique 嘅閃粉一向都好出色 🙂‍↕️

[1 款粉紅色粗閃粉，帶全息閃粉
1 款細緻粉紅閃粉（令我諗起粉紅色 highlighter 色，可以做眼皮頂層色 lid topper）
1 款細緻偏白粉紅、帶冰感珠光（蛋白石、珍珠質感）
1 款細緻粉紅珍珠閃
1 款白色珍珠光]

我有 dasique 3x3 盤，大小差唔多。

總括嚟講，已經好耐冇咁樣令我驚喜嘅眼影盤，所以我強烈推薦呢個作為常備盤。

reviews.text: The shades are beautiful, however, they're not very pigmented. It's easy to create a more natural look. You can always do multiple layers to make it more pigmented. But I enjoy the more natural look. Also, the brown shades have a more reddish tone to them. I wanted to use them for my eyebrows, but they turned out too red.
reviews.zh: 色號好靚，不過發色唔算好。好容易化到自然嘅效果。你可以多疊幾層，令發色更加明顯。但係我都鍾意自然嘅效果。另外，啡色系嘅色號帶少少紅啡調。我本來想用嚟畫眉，但係結果太紅。

reviews.text: I enjoy the palette, it’s easy to use and the size is nice. The color variety is good too. My only complaint is that there was some fallout and also it needed some building up to be as pigmented as I would like. The color pot that came with it is fabulous, and the color looks good on my fair cool toned skin. It serves the purpose I need so I am satisfied with my purchase!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個眼影盤，易用，大細都啱。色彩選擇都幾多。唯一嘅投訴係有啲閃粉散落，而且要疊多幾層先可以達到我想要嘅發色。附送嘅色膏好靚，色號喺我白皙嘅冷色調皮膚上睇落好襯。佢啱我嘅需要，所以我對呢次購買好滿意！

reviews.text: A little too powdery and chalky for my liking. The colors had to be built up but the shades last a good number of hours before fading. Overall a cute palette. I don't think you need this if you already have dasique 's other purple-y palettes. Love the set though!
reviews.zh: 以我嘅喜好嚟講，質地有少少太粉、粉感太重、似粉筆咁乾。要疊色先至發到色，不過色號都可以維持好多個鐘先褪色。整體嚟講，係一盤可愛嘅眼影盤。如果你已經有 dasique 其他偏紫色系嘅眼影盤，我諗你可能唔使買呢款。不過我好鍾意套裝！

reviews.text: I have been a big fan of Dasique's eyeshadow palettes but this one did disappoint me. All the shades look grey on my eyelids once applied, regardless of which one you use. The shimmery shades have a lack of luster. And I do not like the glittery shade that has chunks of glitter in it.
reviews.zh: 我一直好鍾意 Dasique 嘅眼影盤，但係呢盤令我失望。無論用邊個色號，塗喺眼皮上全部都睇落灰灰哋。閃光色號嘅光澤感唔夠。而且我唔鍾意嗰款有粗粒閃粉嘅閃粉色。

reviews.text: The pan sizes were smaller than expected but I guess that helps with space. Eyeshadows were pigmented, easy to build and blend. I think I like this palette more than the peach squeeze palette from dasique since the swatches showed up better on my skin
reviews.zh: 眼影格比預期細，不過我諗咁樣可以慳位。眼影發色好，易疊色、易推開。我覺得我鍾意呢盤多過 dasique 嘅 peach squeeze 盤，因為色卡喺我皮膚上顯色效果好啲。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
